papers.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
papers.breakthrough: AI agent discovers faster matrix-multiplication algorithms (beating Strassen 1969) & optimizes TPU silicon + FlashAttention kernels
papers.authors: Alexander Novikov, Ngân Vũ, Marvin Eisenberger, Emilien Dupont, Po-Sen Huang et al.
papers.summary: An evolutionary coding agent pairing Gemini LLMs with automated evaluators that autonomously discovers novel algorithms, improves Google data-center scheduling, simplifies TPU hardware circuits, and accelerates GPU kernels.

papers.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold
papers.breakthrough: First experimental proof that scaling up quantum qubits exponentially cuts errors below threshold
papers.authors: Rajeev Acharya, Laleh Aghababaie-Beni, Igor Aleiner, Trond I. Andersen, Markus Ansmann et al.
papers.summary: Demonstrated on Google’s Willow superconducting quantum processor that scaling surface codes from distance-3 to distance-5 and distance-7 halves logical error rates — cracking a 30-year barrier in fault-tolerant quantum computing.

papers.title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks
papers.breakthrough: 7M-parameter Tiny Recursive Model outperforms frontier giant LLMs on ARC-AGI & hard puzzles
papers.authors: Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau (Samsung SAIL Montreal)
papers.summary: Discovered that a tiny 2-layer, 7M-parameter recursive network iteratively refining its own latent reasoning state achieves state-of-the-art scores on ARC-AGI, Sudoku-Extreme, and Maze-Hard with <0.01% of frontier LLM parameters.

papers.title: LP5X-PIM Sim: A High-Fidelity HW/SW Integrated Simulator for LPDDR5X-PIM
papers.breakthrough: Processing-in-Memory silicon executing AI compute directly inside mobile LPDDR5X DRAM
papers.authors: SangHoon Cha, Jaewan Choi, Byeongho Kim, Yoonah Paik, Sukhan Lee, Kyomin Sohn
papers.summary: Introduces Samsung Electronics’ hardware-software co-design architecture and high-fidelity simulator for LPDDR5X Processing-in-Memory (PIM), overcoming the memory-bandwidth wall for next-generation on-device LLMs.

papers.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
papers.breakthrough: New neural long-term memory module that learns & memorizes surprises live at test time (>2M tokens)
papers.authors: Ali Behrouz, Peilin Zhong, Vahab Mirrokni
papers.summary: Introduces a neural long-term memory architecture that updates its weights via gradient-based surprise signals during inference — enabling models to scale seamlessly past 2 million tokens while outperforming Transformers and Mamba.

papers.title: Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform for Physical AI
papers.breakthrough: Open physics-aware World Foundation Models generating realistic 3D trajectories for robotics & AVs
papers.authors: NVIDIA Cosmos Team (Niket Agarwal, Arslan Ali, Maciej Bala et al.)
papers.summary: Unveils NVIDIA’s diffusion and autoregressive World Foundation Model platform trained on 20M+ hours of physical-world video, enabling robots and autonomous vehicles to simulate physics, motion, and safety scenarios before acting.

papers.title: ChipNeMo: Domain-Adapted LLMs for Chip Design
papers.breakthrough: Domain-adapted LLMs generating EDA scripts, Verilog/RTL tooling & hardware bug analysis for GPU design
papers.authors: Mingjie Liu, Teodor-Dumitru Ene, Robert Kirby, Chris Cheng, Nathaniel Pinckney, Rongjian Liang et al.
papers.summary: Demonstrates domain-adaptive tokenization, continued pretraining, and retrieval models specialized for industrial silicon engineering — automating EDA script generation, chip architecture Q&A, and hardware bug triage.

papers.title: The Era of 1-bit LLMs: All Large Language Models are in 1.58 Bits
papers.breakthrough: Ternary {-1, 0, +1} weights match FP16 LLMs while eliminating floating-point multiplication
papers.authors: Shuming Ma, Hongyu Wang, Lingxiao Ma, Lei Wang, Wenhui Wang et al.
papers.summary: Introduced BitNet b1.58 where every neural weight is constrained to {-1, 0, +1}, matching full-precision Transformers in perplexity and task quality while slashing energy, memory bandwidth, and latency — paving the way for new 1-bit AI chips.

papers.title: MatterGen: a generative model for inorganic materials design
papers.breakthrough: Generative diffusion AI invents stable novel inorganic crystals synthesized in real labs
papers.authors: Claudio Zeni, Robert Pinsler, Daniel Zügner, Andrew Fowler, Matthew Horton et al.
papers.summary: Discovered a 3D equivariant diffusion model capable of generating brand-new periodic inorganic crystals conditioned on target magnetic, electronic, and mechanical properties — experimentally validated via lab synthesis.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.breakthrough: Pure reinforcement learning spontaneously triggers self-verification & chain-of-thought reasoning
papers.authors: DeepSeek-AI, Daya Guo, Dejian Yang, Haowei Zhang, Junxiao Song et al.
papers.summary: Proved with DeepSeek-R1-Zero and R1 that large-scale pure RL induces emergent "aha moments", reflection, and multi-step verification without supervised reasoning traces — and distilled reasoning into compact open models.

papers.title: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
papers.breakthrough: Hardware-aligned trainable sparse attention delivers up to 11.6× faster long-context decoding
papers.authors: Jingyang Yuan, Huazuo Gao, Damai Dai, Junyu Luo, Liang Zhao et al.
papers.summary: Co-designed dynamic hierarchical sparse attention with modern GPU Tensor Core memory access patterns, achieving end-to-end training and 64K-context inference speedups while outperforming full attention.

papers.title: Meta Large Language Model Compiler: Foundation Models of Compiler Optimization
papers.breakthrough: Foundation AI trained on 546B tokens of LLVM IR & assembly outperforms heuristic compiler passes
papers.authors: Chris Cummins, Volker Seeker, Dejan Grubisic, Baptiste Roziere, Jonas Gehring et al.
papers.summary: Released open foundation models specifically engineered for compiler optimization and programming-language backends — achieving 77% of autotuning search potential for LLVM code-size reduction and 45% exact x86/ARM disassembly.

papers.title: Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens
papers.breakthrough: Eliminates BPE tokenizers completely by dynamically grouping raw bytes by entropy
papers.authors: Artidoro Pagnoni, Ram Pasunuru, Pedro Rodriguez, John Nguyen, Benjamin Muller et al.
papers.summary: Replaces static subword tokenizers with dynamic entropy-based byte patches that allocate more compute only where text or code is unpredictable — cutting inference FLOPs by up to 50% with superior robustness.

papers.title: Exo-GPU: Safe, Imperative, User-schedulable Programming for Tensor Cores
papers.breakthrough: New safe, user-schedulable programming language unlocking manual-level Tensor Core concurrency
papers.authors: David Zhao Akeley, Yuka Ikarashi, Jonathan Ragan-Kelley (MIT CSAIL)
papers.summary: Introduces a novel imperative programming language with compile-time safety checks for GPU memory hierarchies, async data movement, and Tensor Core scheduling — matching hand-tuned CUDA without silent race bugs.

papers.title: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming
papers.breakthrough: Red-team-proven defense slashes universal jailbreak success from 86% down to 4.4%
papers.authors: Mrinank Sharma, Meg Tong, Jesse Mu, Jerry Wei, Jorrit Kruthoff et al.
papers.summary: Discovered lightweight synthetic-data-trained input/output classifiers grounded in explicit constitutional principles that withstood 3,000+ hours of expert adversarial red teaming with minimal false refusals.

papers.title: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
papers.breakthrough: Models explicitly reason over human-written safety specs at inference time before answering
papers.authors: Melody Y. Guan, Manas Joglekar, Eric Wallace, Saachi Jain, Boaz Barak et al.
papers.summary: Pioneered the alignment architecture behind OpenAI’s o-series reasoning models — teaching models to recall and deliberate directly over policy specifications inside their chain-of-thought without relying on massive human-labeled safety sets.

papers.title: Scaling and evaluating sparse autoencoders
papers.breakthrough: Extracts 16 million interpretable monosemantic concepts directly from GPT-4 neural activations
papers.authors: Leo Gao, Tom Dupré la Tour, Henk Tillman, Gabriel Goh, Rajan Troll et al.
papers.summary: Introduced TopK sparse autoencoders and clean scaling laws that decompose opaque frontier-LLM hidden states into millions of sparse, inspectable features — unlocking white-box auditing of neural networks.

papers.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
papers.breakthrough: Asynchronous TMA/WGMMA FP8 GPU kernel design reaches 75%+ H100 utilization (1.2 PFLOPs)
papers.authors: Jay Shah, Ganesh Bikshandi, Ying Zhang, Vijay Thakkar, Pradeep Ramani, Tri Dao
papers.summary: Exploits Hopper GPU warp-specialization, asynchronous Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) transfers, and incoherent block-quantized FP8 to deliver 1.5–2× faster exact attention with 2.6× lower quantization error.

papers.title: rStar-Math: Small LLMs Can Master Math Reasoning with Self-Evolved Deep Thinking
papers.breakthrough: Code-verified MCTS self-play enables compact 7B open LLMs to surpass giant proprietary reasoning models
papers.authors: Xinyu Guan, Li Lyna Zhang, Yifei Liu, Ning Shang, Youran Sun et al.
papers.summary: Discovered a 4-round Monte Carlo Tree Search self-evolution loop where every reasoning step synthesizes and executes Python verification code — boosting 7B open models to 90% on MATH without distilling from larger teachers.

papers.title: Apple Intelligence Foundation Language Models
papers.breakthrough: On-device 3B foundation model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters & verifiable Private Cloud Compute
papers.authors: Tom Gunter, Zirui Wang, Chong Wang, Ruoming Pang, Andy Narayanan et al.
papers.summary: Details Apple Silicon’s privacy-first architecture combining low-bit quantization-aware training, speculative decoding, dynamically swapped task-specific LoRA adapters, and cryptographically verifiable server inference.

papers.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
papers.breakthrough: Unified hybrid Thinking / Non-Thinking open architecture with dynamic per-query reasoning budget
papers.authors: An Yang, Anfeng Li, Baosong Yang, Beichen Zhang, Binyuan Hui et al.
papers.summary: Integrates deep multi-step reasoning and fast instant-response modes inside a single open-weight model family (0.6B–235B MoE) trained on 36T tokens across 119 languages with strong agentic tool-calling and coding performance.
